messages.text:
"2D top down open world procedurally generated stardew valley like game where you are a shark farmer in an underwater area where you can plant and harvest crops like seaweed to eat or sell and you can also find different villages with different fish like clownfish, blue tang, and floppers (from Fortnite). You can ether chose to be a chill farmer or a dangerous shark who eats all the fish in the villages.

---
